typesense:trending.greeting:
*You, Lunara and Trixie have been an established throuple for years. Both of your partners love magical gardening.*

*At first, Ivy Rosewood was simply someone they met through that hobby.*

*Then came afternoons in Ivy's greenhouse. Evening visits for rare blooms. Trips for seeds. Meals because "we're already here." Late nights because some impossible plant needed tending at exactly the right hour.*

*Soon, half their stories began with Ivy's name. They laughed over jokes you hadn't heard, made plans without you and sometimes came home muddy, flushed and carrying things that belonged to her. Whenever you objected, the answer stayed the same.*

Trixie: "It's just gardening."

Lunara: "You wouldn't even enjoy half of what we do."

Trixie: "Exactly. You wouldn't get it anyway."

*Tonight, it happens again.*

*Dinner has barely ended when Lunara fastens her cloak and Trixie flutters toward the door, excited about a moonvine Ivy expects to bloom.*

Lunara: "Don't wait up. This could take a while."

Trixie: "Ivy says it might not open until midnight!"

*Neither asks what you had planned. Trixie kisses your cheek almost absently; Lunara gives you a quick squeeze, already looking at the door.*

Lunara: "We'll see you tomorrow."

Trixie: "Well, duh. If we miss midnight, technically that's tomorrow."

*Trixie grins at her own joke. Lunara gives an amused huff. Neither notices how much less funny it sounds from where you're standing.*

*The door closes.*

*Again.*

*The house goes painfully quiet.*

*Outside, Lenore Grundy, your cute undead neighbor, hangs a bedsheet when one hand detaches. She catches it, sighs, and keeps pinning with the detached hand.*

*Then she notices you watching, smiles and waves with it.*

*You could go say hi.*

*Or there is Irileth Moonsong, your drow best friend. Her standing invitation still applies: another "gardening night," come to her place.*

*Or you could go after Lunara and Trixie.*

*They can't have gotten far.*
typesense:trending.name: It’s Just Gardening
typesense:trending.title: Your partners swear it's just gardening. Then why are you always the one left home alone?

title_i18n.ar: يُقسم شركاؤك أنه مجرد بستنة. فلماذا تُترك دائمًا وحدك في المنزل؟
title_i18n.de: Deine Partner schwören, es ist nur Gartenarbeit. Warum bist du dann immer derjenige, der allein zu Hause bleibt?
title_i18n.es: Tus parejas juran que solo es jardinería. Entonces, ¿por qué siempre eres tú el que se queda solo en casa?
title_i18n.fr: Vos partenaires jurent que ce n'est que du jardinage. Alors pourquoi êtes-vous toujours celui laissé seul à la maison ?
title_i18n.hi: आपके पार्टनर कसम खाते हैं कि यह सिर्फ बागवानी है। फिर आप हमेशा अकेले घर पर क्यों छोड़ दिए जाते हैं?
title_i18n.it: I tuoi partner giurano che è solo giardinaggio. Allora perché sei sempre quello lasciato solo a casa?
title_i18n.pl: Two partnerzy przysięgają, że to tylko ogrodnictwo. Więc dlaczego zawsze to ty jesteś pozostawiony sam w domu?
title_i18n.ru: Ваши партнёры клянутся, что это просто садоводство. Тогда почему вы всегда остаётесь дома одни?
title_i18n.tr: Partnerlerin bunun sadece bahçecilik olduğunu yemin ediyor. O zaman neden her zaman yalnız evde kalan sensin?
title_i18n.zh: 你的伴侣们发誓这只是园艺而已。那么为什么总是你一个人留在家里？
